## Level-Up Flow

**When offered:** Worker computes `shouldLevelUp(character)` (`services/character.ts:159`) — `xp >= XP_THRESHOLDS[level]` and `level < 10`. Thresholds: 0, 300, 900, 2700, 6500, 14000, 23000, 34000, 48000, 64000 (`worker/src/types/index.ts:175`). Returned as `canLevelUp` from `POST /api/action` and `POST /api/combat/resolve`. UI shows a banner (`character-sheet.component.html:66`) and ability picker (`game-console.component.html:19-28`), prompted after combat.

**Trigger:** `levelUp(key)` in `game-console.component.ts:183` → `GameApiService.levelUp(sessionId, characterId, abilityChoice)` (`game-api.service.ts:74`) → **`POST /api/levelup`** (`worker/src/routes/levelup.ts:10`). `abilityChoice` ∈ {str,dex,con,int,wis,cha}; 400 if `!shouldLevelUp`.

**Changes (`services/character.ts:133` `levelUp`):**
- Level += 1
- HP gain = roll(class hit die) + CON modifier, added to both `max_hp` and current HP
- Chosen ability score += 2 (no cap at 20; AC unchanged — this is tracked as Bug B-03-adjacent behavior)
- Hit dice: Fighter/Ranger d10, Rogue/Cleric/Bard d8, Wizard d6 (`CLASS_HIT_DICE`)

Route also logs a `[Level Up]` system row, generates flavor text (`generateLevelUpNarrative`, usually fallback), and adds a DM history turn (`routes/levelup.ts:39-50`). Frontend then calls `setCharacter`, `setCanLevelUp(false)`, shows a system message, updates campaign slot level (`game-console.component.ts:187-194`). Only one level per call — needs repeat calls if XP covers multiple levels.
